open_points.subject: advance_run and execute_function_element mapped value-output schema
open_points.text: a mapped node's value output, once every element succeeded, is one StoredValue holding the canonical JSON array of the elements' values in element order, whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's value_schema as items
open_points.other_text: otherwise JSON outputs are published with put_value_bytes as StoredValues of the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items)
open_points.question: For a mapped output port of cardinality many, must the aggregate schema be an array whose items are the port's value_schema, as the first passage requires, or an array whose items are the individual elements' array schema, as follows from the second passage?
